description: imagepeek: Crop an image to a box or an aspect ratio. To scale instead use image_resize. Returns the image cropped to a box (`left`, `top`, `width`, `height`; out of bounds is a 422 crop_out_of_bounds) or to an `aspect` ratio such as 16:9 placed by `gravity` (center or a side or corner); the reply carries the applied `box`. Reads PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and AVIF; other formats and images over 40 megapixels are refused (not charged). Output: base64 `data_base64`, without EXIF, GPS, XMP or IPTC; over 15 MB or 50 megapixels is a 413 (not charged). Images are not logged; a result is kept only with `output` "url" (24 h). Typically 0.5-2 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 3 imagepeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/image-crop-api.html
